target.statement: BiPS-Chart-7B attains 33.5% on ChartMuseum, a +6.7 point gain over Qwen2.5-VL-7B's 26.8%, demonstrating the main chart-grounding benefit of BiPS training.

compute.basis: The headline BiPS result requires GRPO training of a 7B vision-language model on 13K generated chart samples (reported on 8xH100 GPUs), plus reconstructing the GPT-5-mini-based data pipeline, so it is far beyond a CPU-only laptop; the 14,400 minute estimate is a placeholder for the infeasible training+evaluation job.

blockers: Requires 8xH100 GPUs for GRPO training of Qwen2.5-VL-7B
Uses closed-source GPT-5-mini API in the data-generation pipeline
Final 13K training set and trained weights are not clearly released
Evaluating/training a 7B VLM on a 16 GB CPU-only laptop is impractical
title: See Less, See Right: Bi-directional Perceptual Shaping For Multimodal Reasoning
